outcome: Clinical presentation of severe intrauterine adhesions
Hysteroscopic findings of severe intrauterine adhesions
Aetiological events of severe intrauterine adhesions
cohort: 19 women with severe intrauterine adhesions out of 76 women managed for intrauterine adhesions (constituting 11.9% of 160 infertile women who had diagnostic hysteroscopies)
finding: The main clinical presentation of severe intrauterine adhesions was amenorrhea and infertility, while the major risk factors were complicated caesarean section and myomectomy.
